regions.region: upper-right Table 1, including the generic reaction arrow, entries 1-12, and footnotes a-c
regions.finding: Twelve distinct current-paper experiments were transcribed row by row. The generic arrow is instantiated by those rows and was not duplicated as an extra experiment. Footnotes distinguish isolated yields from 1H NMR yields and specify 45% aqueous HI for entry 5.

regions.region: middle-right Scheme 1 and its monohydrate footnote
regions.finding: Three distinct lithium-halide experiments were transcribed: LiI, LiBr monohydrate, and LiCl monohydrate, with separate times and isolated yields.
One mixed-halide experiment was recorded with NaI and NaCl in a 1:1 ratio, two separately quantified products, and the reported 2a:2c ratio.
A no-reaction experiment for 1,2-decadiene with NaI in HOAc was retained, including 82% starting-allene recovery.
A no-reaction experiment for crotonic acid with NaI in HOAc was retained, including 98% acid recovery.

regions.region: left-column introduction and the mechanistic discussion surrounding equations 1-3
regions.finding: Background hydrochlorination failures are attributed to cited prior work, and the nucleophilic-addition discussion is a mechanistic inference without a depicted mechanism. Neither was represented as a new current-paper experiment.

unresolved: Most rows do not report reactant/reagent quantities, atmosphere, reaction concentration, or row-specific workup details.
No Supporting Information file is supplied or associated in this pilot.

regions.finding: One product-stability/isomerization experiment was recorded: 2a with NaI in HOAc at 25 °C for 6 h, giving 92% recovered 2a and less than 2% 4-iodo-3-penten-2-one.

regions.region: lower-left Experimental Section, typical procedure for 2a, continuing at the top of the right column
regions.finding: The detailed charge, reaction, workup, purification, isolated mass, and 69% yield were merged into Table 1 entry 1. The same paragraph reports a 3-4% isomer outcome for that NaI/1a experiment; it was merged into the same record rather than duplicated.

These are characterization data and a broad statement that the compounds were prepared similarly under Scheme 1/Table 1 conditions. They do not identify additional distinct reaction runs and were not duplicated as new experiments.

regions.region: left-column prior-method paragraph and Starting Materials paragraph
regions.finding: The synthetic routes and starting-material preparations are cited prior literature, not fully described current-paper experiments, so no current-paper experiment records were created from them.

regions.region: right-column statement on equations 1-4 and Supporting Information notice
regions.finding: The 1H NMR/CH2Br2 measurement basis was applied to equations 1-4. The article mentions five SI pages of spectra, but no SI file is supplied or associated in the workspace.

unresolved: The measurement basis of the 3-4% minor isomer in the Table 1 entry 1 experiment is not stated explicitly.
The broad 'prepared similarly' statement does not provide row-specific charge or workup details for 2b-2i.
The mentioned Supporting Information spectra were not supplied and no SI association was inferred.
